description: Several large plastic building blocks sit on the bedspread in front of a pillow: a long blue base piece, and smaller green, white, yellow, and red blocks. The right hand reaches in from the right to pick up the white block and presses it onto the blue base, then lifts the yellow block and snaps it onto the growing stack while the left hand hovers near the green block; next the left hand brings the green block in to connect alongside, and the right hand places the red block on top, pressing down to secure it.
